title: Trump v3.0 | The Most Viral Content Creator | StandUp Comedy by Rahul Dua | 2026
description:
AUS-NZ Tour 2026 Tickets: https://linktr.ee/therahulduatour

Roz subah ek nayi fuddu baat. Greenland chahiye, Venezuela mein tel chahiye, Iran acha aadmi nahi hai, H1B dena hai… ya nahi dena? Sir Donald J. Trump: Part time Politician, full time content creator! 

With successful viral content pieces such as H1B Visa panic, Greenland, Venezuela and Iran takeover, global oil politics, tariff threats and stock market mood swings, the man has aced everything. And so have I, in this StandUp video trying to explain world geopolitics better than most news channels. In addition to the plight of Indian immigrants in the USA, by covering topics like Trump vs Greenland, Tariffs, H1B Visa drama, stock market volatility, Nobel Peace Prize and Venezuela takeover, I have tried to explain why every Trump announcement feels like a Netflix season finale. 

If you’re an NRI, or a desi abroad, or just someone trying to make sense of world news - this one’s for you.

Pls don’t forget to LIKE the video, leave a COMMENT and SHARE the video as it really helps favour the algorithm. Jaate jaate SUBSCRIBE bhi kar dete to maza sa hi aa jaata! 

Drop me a follow on Instagram for regular bite size content: https://www.instagram.com/therahuldua
